name: User checkout journey
description: Publishes user, order, and payment events and waits for each backend record.

steps.name: Publish user.created
steps.description: Sends a user.created message to the mock backend.
steps.poll_query: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mock_events WHERE flow_step = 'checkout-create-user')

steps.name: Publish order.created
steps.description: Sends an order.created message to the mock backend.
steps.poll_query: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mock_events WHERE flow_step = 'checkout-create-order')

steps.name: Publish payment.captured
steps.description: Sends a payment.captured message to the mock backend.
steps.poll_query: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mock_events WHERE flow_step = 'checkout-capture-payment')
